fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious output redirection to the local admins share, this technique is often found in malicious scripts or hacktool stagers
fields.name: Suspicious Redirection to Local Admin Share
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ">" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\\\127.0.0.1\\admin$\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\\\localhost\\admin$\\")))
